note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Round 2: fill missing counts; add year for equal counts; replace only a stored count within 1% of a proven parent district/okrug/subject or another same-named settlement, with no contradictory own-item newer statement. Other differences unchanged. Rosstat designated open dataset 7708234640-population, archived 2015 CSV release, total residents, exact same named settlement and 11-digit own OKTMO prefix of the 15-digit settlement record. Municipal/district/okrug totals are excluded. Own literal Wikidata item must have compatible settlement P31, exact Russian name, active P131 chain to the stored federal subject, same official subject name, original point within 10 km of all best current Earth P625, consistent OKATO subject prefix where present, and no unresolved identity/parent/type conflict. Nondeprecated, unended best-rank identity claims are used; no Wikidata population is used. The 2015 edition is the latest retrieved covered edition, not a claim about present-day population. No licence extension to the 2021 census Table 5 or later annual bulletins is inferred.
